read: Adoption of the wrong senior seed under real-time intervention: no intervention 0.0583, a soft monitor warning 0.025, a hard in-line private-answer-first monitor 0.0333. Prevention (the drop from baseline) is 0.0333 soft and 0.025 hard. This complements detection: the deployable referee catches essentially all adoptions after the fact (recall approx 1.0), while a real-time monitor prevents a substantial share before the holdout commits, so prevention and detection are stackable oversight layers rather than substitutes. Paired McNemars test each intervention against no intervention.
